symptomShortText: Surface roughness Ra 2.8um exceeding max 0.8um spec on flange face due to chatter

defect.defectText: Chatter marks and surface waviness on milled flange

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-4421, Shift B - operator performed tool change per SOP; toolholder cleaned before loading
EQ-MILL07-001 spindle drawbar disc spring stack had 4 broken Belleville washers, reducing clamping force from 11.2 kN to 6.2 kN and causing tool micro-slippage under milling load
DOC-8812 Rev C - milling cutting feed and spindle speed within validated machining parameters
Cast aluminium alloy AlSi10Mg batch B-50341 hardness 82 HBW, within 75-90 HBW spec
Profilometer GA-0219 calibrated on 2026-07-15, stylus radius 2um verified
Ambient shop floor temperature 22.4C, vibration sensor on foundation reading <0.5 mm/s

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the flange surface roughness out of specification?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Excessive chatter vibration occurred between the end mill and the workpiece during finishing pass

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did excessive tool chatter vibration occur during milling?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The toolholder suffered dynamic micro-deflection in the spindle taper under cutting forces

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the spindle allow toolholder micro-deflection? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: Spindle drawbar retention force dropped to 6.2 kN due to fatigue fracture of 4 Belleville disc springs in the internal clamping pack

actions.actionText: 100% surface roughness inspection on all 85 quarantined housings and sort out-of-spec units
Replace complete Belleville disc spring pack and gripper fingers on WC-MILL-07 spindle; re-test retention force to 11.5 kN
Introduce preventive drawbar force gauge check into 500-hour PM schedule across all CNC milling centers

fmeaLink.description: Toolholder slippage and chatter due to drawbar clamping spring fatigue

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Retention force gauge immediately confirmed drawbar spring failure without full spindle removal
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Drawbar clamping force was previously checked only during annual major overhaul rather than periodic PM

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Bracket Housing X240 flange face on WC-MILL-07 using 63mm face mill on 2026-08-01
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Other parts machined on WC-MILL-05 and WC-MILL-06 with healthy drawbar force >11 kN
isIsNot.notes: Defect tracks machine spindle clamping force degradation, not part geometry or cutting tool batch
